evidence.statement: Across 66 archived genome pairs, 8166/10836 shared MOP token-pair memberships have no shared literal 16-nt implementation.
Among broad boundary-role shared token-pair memberships, 240/579 recur at the masked-token level without a shared literal 16-mer implementation.

The archived data contain a measurable representation stack in which masked identity often persists beyond literal implementation identity; whether this reflects conserved biological semantics requires prospective validation.

unknowns: Whether masked-only boundary recurrence corresponds to conserved molecular role.
